coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Six of nine ground-truth variable items match: WikiText-2 evaluation at sequence length 2048, an unquantized 16-bit baseline, 4/3/2-bit weights, all four quantization methods, perplexity, and numerical stability monitoring.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The model list replaces LLAMA2-70B with LLaMA-3-8B. Quantization is symmetric rather than asymmetric, and granularity varies instead of remaining per-column. The weight-only specification permits BF16 and does not explicitly keep KV caches in FP16. Additional datasets, benchmarks, and controls expand beyond the intended experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No results or conclusion are supplied, including the low-bit benefits of QuaRot-GPTQ, RTN failures, limited stabilization of RTN by QuaRot, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
